documentation.text:
@dev Pauses the contract, preventing certain state-changing operations.
 Only the owner (University) or an Admin can pause the contract.

@dev Unpauses the contract, allowing previously restricted state-changing operations.
 Only the owner (University) or an Admin can unpause the contract.

Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

assignGrade(address,bytes32,uint256).details: Assigns a grade to a student for a specific course. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can assign grades.

params._courseId: The course ID for which the grade is being assigned.
params._score: The numerical score (0-100) achieved by the student.
params._studentAddress: The address of the student to assign the grade to.

completeSemester(address,string,string,s.details: Marks the current semester as completed for a specific student and calculates its final performance. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can complete semesters. Updates the student's overall academic performance after semester completion. If the student meets graduation requirements, a graduation certificate is proposed.

params._collegeName: The name of the college within the institution.
params._institutionName: The name of the issuing institution/university.
params._programName: The name of the academic program/major.

constructor.details: Constructor for the StudentAcademicManager contract. Executed once upon deployment.

params._certificatesContractAddress: The address of the Certificates.sol contract for certificate issuance.
params._identityContractAddress: The address of the Identity.sol contract for cross-contract interaction.

getAcademicActionDetails(uint256).details: Retrieves the details of a specific academic action.

params._actionId: The ID of the academic action.

returns.actionId: The ID of the academic action.
returns.endDate: The end date of the action.
returns.isActive: True if the action is still active.
returns.startDate: The start date of the action.
returns.studentAddress: The address of the student who received the action.

getCourseDetails(bytes32).details: Retrieves details of a specific course.

params._courseId: The unique identifier of the course.

returns.credits: The number of credits for the course.
returns.isActive: True if the course is active.
returns.name: The name of the course.
returns.passingScore: The passing score for the course.

getCurrentSemesterNumber(address).details: Retrieves the current semester number for a specific student.

getOverallAcademicPerformance(address).details: Retrieves a student's overall academic performance details.

returns.lastUpdated: The timestamp of the last update to the academic performance.
returns.totalAttemptedCredits: The total credits attempted by the student.
returns.totalEarnedCredits: The total credits successfully earned by the student.

getSemesterPerformanceDetails(address,ui.details: Retrieves a student's academic performance details for a specific semester.

returns.earnedCreditsThisSemester: The credits earned in that semester.
returns.endDate: The end date of the semester.
returns.isCompleted: True if the semester has been marked as completed.
returns.semesterGPA: The student's GPA for that semester.
returns.semesterGrade: The student's letter grade for that semester.
returns.semesterPercentage: The student's percentage for that semester.
returns.startDate: The start date of the semester.
returns.totalAttemptedCreditsThisSemester: The total credits attempted in that semester.

getStudentAcademicActions(address).details: Retrieves a list of academic action IDs taken against a specific student.

returns._0: An array of academic action IDs.

getStudentGrade(address,bytes32).details: Retrieves a student's grade for a specific course.

params._courseId: The unique identifier of the course.

returns.score: The student's score in the course.
returns.timestamp: The timestamp when the grade was assigned.

getStudentWarnings(address).details: Retrieves a list of warning IDs issued to a specific student.

getWarningDetails(uint256).details: Retrieves the details of a specific warning.

returns.isActive: True if the warning is still active.
returns.studentAddress: The address of the student who received the warning.
returns.timestamp: The timestamp when the warning was issued.

issueWarning(address,uint8,string).details: Issues an academic or behavioral warning to a student. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can issue warnings.

params._studentAddress: The address of the student to whom the warning is issued.
params._warningType: The type of warning (Academic, Behavioral, Attendance).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: Pauses the contract, preventing certain state-changing operations. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can pause the contract.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

registerCourse(bytes32,string,uint256,ui.details: Registers a new course in the system. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can register courses.

params._courseId: A unique identifier for the course (e.g., a hash of its name).
params._credits: The number of credits for the course.
params._passingScore: The minimum score required to pass the course (out of 100).

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

startNewSemester(address,uint256,uint256.details: Initiates a new semester for a specific student. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can start new semesters. Requires the previous semester (if any) to be completed.

params._endDate: The end timestamp of the new semester.
params._startDate: The start timestamp of the new semester.

takeAcademicAction(address,uint8,string,.details: Takes an academic disciplinary action against a student (e.g., probation, suspension, dismissal). Only the owner (University) or an Admin can take academic actions. If the action is suspension or dismissal, the student's status in the Identity contract may be updated.

params._durationInDays: The duration of the action in days (if applicable, e.g., for suspension).
params._studentAddress: The address of the student receiving the action.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

unpause().details: Unpauses the contract, allowing previously restricted state-changing operations. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can unpause the contract.
